import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
scatter = axes[0, 0].scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                             c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='viridis', 
                             s=df['Physical Activity Level']/2, alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Stress Level\n(Size = Physical Activity)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[0, 0])
cbar.set_label('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=10)

# 2. Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation (top 10)
occupation_avg = df.groupby('Occupation').agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean',
    'Stress Level': 'mean'
}).sort_values('Sleep Duration', ascending=False).head(10)

x = np.arange(len(occupation_avg))
width = 0.25
axes[0, 1].bar(x - width, occupation_avg['Sleep Duration'], width, label='Sleep Duration', color='skyblue')
axes[0, 1].bar(x, occupation_avg['Quality of Sleep'], width, label='Quality of Sleep', color='lightgreen')
axes[0, 1].bar(x + width, occupation_avg['Stress Level'], width, label='Stress Level', color='salmon')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Average Score', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Top 10 Occupations: Sleep & Stress Metrics', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xticks(x)
axes[0, 1].set_xticklabels(occupation_avg.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 1].legend()

# 3. Distribution of Sleep Duration by BMI Category
bmi_order = ['Underweight', 'Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
for bmi in bmi_order:
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]
    axes[0, 2].hist(subset['Sleep Duration'], alpha=0.5, label=bmi, bins=15)
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 2].legend()

# 4. Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Features
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                  'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
im = axes[1, 0].imshow(corr_matrix, cmap='coolwarm', vmin=-1, vmax=1)
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(np.arange(len(numerical_cols)))
axes[1, 0].set_yticks(np.arange(len(numerical_cols)))
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(numerical_cols, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=10)
axes[1, 0].set_yticklabels(numerical_cols, fontsize=10)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Correlation Matrix of Numerical Features', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=axes[1, 0])
cbar.set_label('Correlation Coefficient', fontsize=10)

# Add correlation values
for i in range(len(numerical_cols)):
    for j in range(len(numerical_cols)):
        text = axes[1, 0].text(j, i, f'{corr_matrix.iloc[i, j]:.2f}',
                               ha="center", va="center", color="black", fontsize=8)

# 5. Daily Steps vs Heart Rate by Gender
genders = df['Gender'].unique()
colors = {'Male': 'blue', 'Female': 'red'}
for gender in genders:
    subset = df[df['Gender'] == gender]
    axes[1, 1].scatter(subset['Daily Steps'], subset['Heart Rate'], 
                       alpha=0.6, label=gender, color=colors[gender], s=50)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Daily Steps vs Heart Rate by Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].legend()

# 6. Sleep Quality Distribution by Stress Level
stress_levels = sorted(df['Stress Level'].unique())
sleep_quality_by_stress = [df[df['Stress Level'] == level]['Quality of Sleep'] for level in stress_levels]
bp = axes[1, 2].boxplot(sleep_quality_by_stress, labels=stress_levels, patch_artist=True)
axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 2].set_title('Sleep Quality Distribution by Stress Level', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Color the boxes
colors_box = plt.cm.YlOrRd(np.linspace(0.3, 0.9, len(stress_levels)))
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], colors_box):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)

plt.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
